dialogues.speaker: Sumizome's Likeness
dialogues.text: (This is Sumizome's likeness, as done by Albedo.)

dialogues.speaker: Sumizome's Likeness
dialogues.text: (Ayaka was the model for this picture, and it depicts Sumizome rinsing the poetry collection in water, with a little extra flair, of course.)

dialogues.speaker: Sumizome's Likeness
dialogues.text: ("You know, the Sumizome drawn here really looks like the Shirasagi Himegimi," so most of the guests have said. This portrait has also proved the most popular in terms of photos taken with it.)
